system.description:
You spin your weapon around in a ring around you, extending it with your chakra to create two rings of death. All creatures within a 15-foot radius must make a Dexterity Saving Throw, taking your [Weapons damage] + [Weapons damage] and gaining a rank of Weakened on a failed save or take half damage on a success. Creatures within your weapons range make their save at disadvantage and if they fail their save, gain 2 ranks of Weakened instead of 1.

Chain 2: Defense is part of a good offense. Roll your [Weapons damage], recording the result. You gain DR equal to the result until the beginning of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost by 3. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the damage by [Weapons damage].
